entities.name: Gonti's Aether Heart
entities.description: Legendary aether-powered artificial heart used by Gonti that lets an aetherborn live far past their normal lifespan.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: Aetherborn crime lord on Avishkar who uses the heart.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Artificer whom Gonti enlisted to fix the heart.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where Gonti's Aether Heart is found.

events.summary: Gonti enlists Saheeli Rai to fix the heart, claiming to hold her family hostage; afterwards he reveals they were never in danger.
events.quote: Gonti once had to enlist the help of Saheeli Rai to fix it

relations.note: He uses it to live long.
relations.quote: an artificial heart currently used by Gonti
